title: Built a vampire sim for Halloween with Opus 5.5, Three.js & WebGL2
author: Particular-Let9884
selftext:
Hey everyone! I wanted to share **Noctyhr**, a little vampire simulation game I’ve been working on for Halloween. 🦇

You wake up as a vampire, feed to survive, and work toward conquering your own kingdom. You can also encounter other vampire counts along the way—you’re not the only one roaming the night.

I built it with Opus 5.5, using Three.js and WebGL2 for lighting effects to give the world a dark, Halloween atmosphere.

[Try Noctyhr here](https://nocthyr.higgsfield.app/)

Anyone else here building something spooky for Halloween? 🎃
